newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world sugar weaker and rangebound.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world sugar weaker and rangebound.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were weaker at midsession amid light local selling, floor sources said.
The market clung to its recent trading range as benchmark October held above its downside target of 11.10 cents a lb, and lingered below resistance at Thursday's high of 11.22 cents.
"Until we break out either way, there is not much to say," a trader said.
The U.S. holiday weekend and a dearth of physical offtake contributed to the market's dull tone, he added.
Only 3,911 lots were estimated to have changed hands as of 1100 EDT.
Most-active October was 0.04 cent wwaker at 11.14 cents, traded 11.20 cents to 11.12 cents. The rest were off 0.01 to 0.06 cent as of 1130.
Open interest in October fell 1,158 lots to 94,278 lots as of early Thursday. March declined 354 lots to 42,029 lots.
